nws_afd.quote: The earliest that any model guidance shows marine layer clouds/fog returning to the coastal areas is Wed night/Thu morning, but the models have historically been slow with the return of the marine layer after a Santa Ana event so we'll be monitoring this closely.

alerts.headline: Extreme Heat Warning issued October 4 at 4:28AM PDT until October 8 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Dangerously hot conditions with high temperatures ranging
from the mid 80s to low 90s at the beaches to the mid 90s to around
100 for inland coastal areas expected. Nights will be very warm
with low temperatures in the low to mid 70s.

* WHERE...Orange County Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM PDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Heat related illnesses increase significantly during
extreme heat events.
